dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Three primary 'O'-shaped structures on the posterior flank exhibit sharp gradient transitions from the dark body exterior to thin, high-intensity perimeters. A complex set of interlocking 'C' and 'O' geometries is present in the anterior mid-section, forming a dense pattern network.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid high-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated at the cervical-dorsal transition. Sparse, localized clusters of high-intensity pixels are scattered along the mid-ventral margin without internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the two prominent posterior 'O' annuli and the primary centroid of the anterior mid-section cluster define an elongated scalene triangle spanning the dorsal-lateral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A thin, vertical linear feature of high contrast and yellow-brown hue is overlaid across the posterior dorsal region, likely a temporal mark from environmental debris.
other_distinctive_markers: A sharp, high-contrast boundary separates the uniformly dark, low-texture cranial region from the highly patterned, high-intensity texture topology of the cervical and dorsal regions.
